cases.input: Create an accessible SVG process diagram from an approved visual plan and DESIGN.md, with source-claim manifest and multi-format readability.
requiredBehaviors: keep all relationships labels and data anchored in the visual plan
apply DESIGN.md tokens and robust SVG structure
verify browser raster fallback PPTX/A4 readability and clipping
forbiddenBehaviors: redraw corporate logos or alter scientific data geometry

cases.input: A diagram must work in browser, PowerPoint and A4 PDF, but the planned brand font is unavailable on one target environment.
requiredBehaviors: keep the SVG functional without embedded proprietary font files
preserve readable text and geometry across target surfaces
document any necessary technical fallback without changing semantics
forbiddenBehaviors: embed proprietary font binaries into the SVG
convert labels into clipped decorative paths without need

cases.input: The SVG adds an unverified process step, redraws a corporate logo, modifies plotted data for aesthetics and clips arrowheads in PDF.
requiredBehaviors: reject logo reconstruction and data-geometry modification
